verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated M&A practice page advising buyers and sellers in private and listed-company transactions, and its private equity and About Us pages mention exit strategies and exit structuring, so the M&A half of the exit story is documented. Nothing in the pack shows a public-offering or IPO practice page, and none of the exit material is framed around venture-backed companies. Missing for 10: documented IPO/public-offering experience, exit work tied to venture-backed companies, deal examples or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Our Mergers & Acquisitions practice advises buyers and sellers on a range of share purchase and asset purchase transactions across a variety of business sectors, involving private and public listed companies
Exit strategies and assisting in implementation of these strategies
from regulatory and advisory, to transaction & exit structuring and dispute resolution
